// diagnostic

E0917

`#Inline(Always) fn` calls itself — inlining a recursive call has no fixed expansion (D-METHODMACRO1)

What

`#Inline(Always) fn` calls itself — inlining a recursive call has no fixed expansion (D-METHODMACRO1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0917

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0917: tests/ui/inline_always_recursive.stderr.

Error [E0917]: `factorial` calls itself, so `#Inline(Always)` cannot expand it
  --> tests/ui/inline_always_recursive.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | #Inline(Always) fn factorial(n: Int) Int -> {
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: inlining a recursive call would either loop forever at compile time or require an artificial depth cutoff — neither is a real inline.
 Fix: drop `#Inline(Always)` (use `#Inline` as a hint), or restructure the function to be non-recursive.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0917
